scope: BLS-owned public documentation audit of scheduled-versus-actual timestamp provenance only; one event type; target calendar span 2021-01-01 through 2025-06-30.
decision_basis: BLS annual schedules and dissemination policy document a scheduled 08:30 Eastern Time convention, but the permitted value-free sources do not establish a complete target-period actual-release ledger, a documented ET/DST-to-JST conversion, revision/republication timestamp semantics, or an OSE session and trade_date alignment rule. Scheduled timestamps are therefore not silently promoted to actual event timestamps; all ambiguous cases fail closed.

attributes.basis: BLS-S06 identifies the Employment Situation archived-news-release series, and BLS-S07 lists The Employment Situation among BLS PFEI releases. This audit admits no second indicator or economic field.

BLS-S01 through BLS-S05 display scheduled date/time entries for the target span, but none supplies a value-free, event-by-event actual-publication timestamp record. BLS-S06 is an archive index, not an actual-timestamp ledger. No scheduled row is used as actual.

BLS-S07 says release schedules are published in advance and that rare technical delays may occur; it does not map each scheduled target-period event to its actual publication, cancellation, postponement, or emergency-change status. The annual schedules do not close that gap.
The allowed BLS sources label the schedule Eastern Time, but none documents target-event daylight-saving status or an ET-to-JST conversion rule. No JST timestamp is calculated or admitted.

BLS-S06 cautions that archived release data may later be revised, but the allowed sources do not state whether a revision or republication preserves, supersedes, or supplies the timestamp required for the original event. No value or revised value is accessed.
The BLS-only source set contains no OSE session calendar, session-boundary definition, or trade_date mapping. A future post-release match cannot be made from this audit.
